cases.sentence: Девять дней после оставления Москвы, в Петербург приехал посланный от Кутузова с ___ об оставлении Москвы.
cases.explain: «официальным известием» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Nine days after the abandonment of Moscow, a messenger from Kutúzov reached Petersburg with the official announcement of that event. This messenger was Michaud, a Frenchman who did not know Russian, but who was quoique étranger, russe de coeur et d’âme,109 as he said of himself.

cases.sentence: Государь тотчас же принял посланного в своем кабинете, во дворце ___.
cases.explain: «Каменного острова» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The Emperor at once received this messenger in his study at the palace on Stone Island. Michaud, who had never seen Moscow before the campaign and who did not know Russian, yet felt deeply moved (as he wrote) when he appeared before notre très gracieux souverain110 with the news of the burning of Moscow, dont les flammes éclairaient sa route.111

cases.sentence: Государь тяжело и часто стал дышать, ___ его задрожала, и прекрасные голубые глаза мгновенно увлажились слезами.
cases.explain: «нижняя губа» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Has the enemy entered the city?” he asked. “Yes, sire, and Moscow is now in ashes. I left it all in flames,” replied Michaud in a decided tone, but glancing at the Emperor he was frightened by what he had done.

cases.sentence: Государь тяжело и часто стал дышать, нижняя губа его задрожала, и прекрасные ___ мгновенно увлажились слезами.
cases.explain: «голубые глаза» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Has the enemy entered the city?” he asked. “Yes, sire, and Moscow is now in ashes. I left it all in flames,” replied Michaud in a decided tone, but glancing at the Emperor he was frightened by what he had done.

cases.sentence: Увидав успокоение своего très gracieux souverain,[902] всемилостивого повелителя, Мишо тоже успокоился, но на прямой ___ государя, требовавший и прямого ответа, он не успел еще приготовить ответа.
cases.explain: «существенный вопрос» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Seeing that his most gracious ruler was calm once more, Michaud also grew calm, but was not immediately ready to reply to the Emperor’s direct and relevant question which required a direct answer.

cases.sentence: Увидав успокоение своего très gracieux souverain,[902] всемилостивого повелителя, Мишо тоже успокоился, но на прямой существенный вопрос государя, требовавший и ___, он не успел еще приготовить ответа.
cases.explain: «прямого ответа» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Seeing that his most gracious ruler was calm once more, Michaud also grew calm, but was not immediately ready to reply to the Emperor’s direct and relevant question which required a direct answer.

cases.sentence: — Colonel, je l’éxige toujours,[903] Государь, позволите ли вы мне говорить откровенно, как подобает ___?
cases.explain: «прямому воину» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “Sire, will you allow me to speak frankly as befits a loyal soldier?” he asked to gain time. “Colonel, I always require it,” replied the Emperor. “Conceal nothing from me, I wish to know absolutely how things are.”

cases.sentence: Я оставил всю армию, начиная с начальников и до ___, без исключения, в великом, отчаянном страхе...
cases.explain: «последнего солдата» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Sire!” said Michaud with a subtle, scarcely perceptible smile on his lips, having now prepared a well-phrased reply, “sire, I left the whole army, from its chiefs to the lowest soldier, without exception in desperate and agonized terror …”

cases.sentence: — успокоенно и с ___ глаз, сказал государь, ударяя по плечу Мишо.
cases.explain: «ласковым блеском» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Ah!” said the Emperor reassured, and with a kindly gleam in his eyes, he patted Michaud on the shoulder. “You set me at ease, Colonel.”

cases.sentence: Постояв там несколько мгновений, он ___ вернулся к Мишо и сильным жестом сжал его руку пониже локтя.
cases.explain: «большими шагами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Well, then, go back to the army,” he said, drawing himself up to his full height and addressing Michaud with a gracious and majestic gesture, “and tell our brave men and all my good subjects wherever you go that when I have not a soldier left I shall put myself at the head of my beloved nobility and my good peasants and so use the last resources of my empire. It still offers me more than my enemies suppose,” said the Emperor growing more and more animated; “but should it ever be ordained by Divine Providence,” he continued, raising to heaven his fine eyes shining with emotion, “that my dynasty should cease to reign on the throne of my ancestors, then after exhausting all the means at my command, I shall let my beard grow to here” (he pointed halfway down his chest) “and go and eat potatoes with the meanest of my peasants, rather than sign the disgrace of my country and of my beloved people whose sacrifices I know how to appreciate.” Having uttered these words in an agitated voice the Emperor suddenly turned away as if to hide from Michaud the tears that rose to his eyes, and went to the further end of his study. Having stood there a few moments, he strode back to Michaud and pressed his arm below the elbow with a vigorous movement. The Emperor’s mild and handsome face was flushed and his eyes gleamed with resolution and anger.
